lessons.keep: Keep the same named feature visible from planning through the resulting application preview.
try: For a referral-feature demo, show two design options, the selected option and its matching final panel together.
Build a preview transition from an isolated feature card to its full app context, holding each readable state.
lessons.avoid: Avoid treating large green test labels as evidence of a verified build.
lessons.open: How closely does the generated feature match selected decisions, and what tests actually ran?
